raw:
The 3+ deck is rewritten as 50 open questions under DEC-47 option c, and it is committed in two commits on feature/US-01-02 (not pushed). The gates and the whole acceptance suite are green on head dbfde5b.

**What changed**
- **DEC-47** in /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/docs/specs/DECISIONS.md is now the confirmed entry. It is decided by the product owner (delivery loop, confirmed 2026-10-14), names option c, keeps every Affects item and is accepted. The Why says it is critical. It also says the 4+ and 5+ decks follow the same rule (open questions), which answers spec N1 and code N5. The title changed to match the ruling. Because DEC-47 exists only on this branch, the diff from main still only adds lines.
- **The deck** (/Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/src/content/decks/3-plus.json) has no either/or questions left. I checked every question in both languages against all the near misses earlier rounds flagged, and reworded or swapped a question wherever another correct answer was left.
  - Swapped facts: 3p-01, 03, 04, 06, 11, 12, 18, 19, 20, 23, 25, 28, 32, 33, 39, 43, 45, 47, 48, 50.
- **Independent review:** a reviewer subagent attacked the draft. It found one remaining near miss, 3p-15: a child could answer "z kałuży" (the puddle) for the ice on a frozen puddle. The question is now just "Z czego jest lód?" / "What is ice made of?". I also took its wording fixes for 3p-01, 06, 17, 23, 28 and 47.
- **The record** (/Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/docs/delivery/content-checks/US-01-02-3-plus.md) has a new column, "Near misses checked". Each row names the answers tried against that question and why each one is ruled out. The list of the four questions that stayed open is gone.
- **The record test and its spec** (/Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/tests/unit/AC-01-02-4-age-suitability-record.test.js and /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/docs/delivery/tests/AC-01-02-4-age-suitability-record.md) check the new layout.
  - Steps 1 to 3 check as before: one row per question, unique ids, row count equal to the deck length, texts matching the deck in pl and en, and all four checks passing. Rows now have nine cells after the id.
  - New step 4: the near-miss cell must not be empty, "—" or "none".
  - New step 5 is the guard: no 3+ question may contain the word "czy" in Polish or "or" in English.

**Tests:** I started the API 32 emulator (AVD Medium_Phone) myself and stopped it after the run. There was one run, test-runs/2026-10-14_190107, on clean head dbfde5b with a snapshot; there was no SIGSEGV, so no re-run. It holds 53/53 unit tests, the release APK checks and 4/4 Maestro flows. As in every earlier round, run.json counts only the Maestro flows (pass 4, skipped 8). The AC-01-02 Jest tests passed in junit/unit.xml and CI matches them by id.
